name: Tax Identification Number (TIN)
note: Nauru's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: the Nauru Revenue Office is the only office with authority to issue a TIN under the Revenue Administration Act 2014; its registration generates a 9-digit unique number for every taxpayer, employers and employees alike, one per employee however many employers. Read as given on starting work, to workers. No check rule, age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Nauru: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: The NRO is the only office which has the authority to issue a TIN under the RAA; • The Nauru TIN registration process generates a 9 digit unique tax identification number for every taxpayer including employers/payers and employees/ payees;
